title: Song Pal Time (Text Tapped Out)
style: Accusation-laced drift phonk and slowed mansion-club for car POV: half-time 85 BPM with detuned piano trance stabs, wide choir pad, dusty vinyl hiss, distorted 808 slides, beatbox layers, neo-funk groove, and male rap vocals. Tempo-shift snaps to 170 BPM chase bridge with rolling toms, clipped snare, saturated bass, and hard drop., powerful drops, choir chorus, beat box, subtle piano, dark tones
lyrics:
Song Title: Song Pal Time (Text Tapped Out)
Production Direction: Neo-funk groove, rap male vocals, choir on chorus, beatbox layers, heavy 808s, powerful drops, subtle piano stabs, energetic but smooth.
[Intro] (spoken/sung low over subtle piano + light beatbox)
You tapped out…
Text out…
Song pal time.
[Verse 1] (rap male vocals)
Phone in your hand, thumbs moving fast
Another late-night text, but it ain’t gonna last
You typed it, you sent it, then you tapped out the chat
Now the screen went quiet… but the vibe still at bat
Text stepped out the ring, left the drama on read
I saw the signal fading, so I stepped in instead
No more typing circles, no more back and forth
We turning all that tension into something you can’t ignore
[Pre-Chorus] (build with piano + 808 swell)
The text is tapped out
The text stepped out
The song is sung
Now we won the fight
[Chorus] (choir + full beat + powerful drop)
Song pal time!
Songs in the ring — come and sing!
The ring is to sing, not to fight
Text tapped out, now we make it right
Text to sound — that’s up to you
Sing it back to me, let’s hear that vibe too
Song pal time!
Cool pal, sung pal, let the beat come through
We don’t text no more… we let the song speak for you
[Verse 2] (rap male vocals + beatbox accents)
You tapped out the message, I tapped into the groove
Turned your half-typed feelings into something that moves
No more “read 2:14” with no reply
Now the bassline answering every question you asked why
Text back up? Nah — we raising the bar
From the keyboard to the vocal booth, we raising the bar
You wanted connection, now you got the whole track
Text to sound, sound to soul — ain’t no going back
[Pre-Chorus] (build)
The text is tapped out
The text stepped out
The song is sung
Now we won the fight
[Chorus] (bigger choir + drop)
Song pal time!
Songs in the ring — come and sing!
The ring is to sing, not to fight
Text tapped out, now we make it right
Text to sound — that’s up to you
Sing it back to me, let’s hear that vibe too
Song pal time!
Cool pal, sung pal, let the beat come through
We don’t text no more… we let the song speak for you
[Bridge] (half-time neo-funk feel, subtle piano)
You don’t gotta explain it twice
Just throw me the vibe and I’ll build it nice
From the argument to the anthem
From the silence to the dancing
Text tapped out… but the music stepped in
Now we winning every round — this is how we begin
[Final Chorus] (full power — choir, 808s, beatbox, big drop)
Song pal time!
Songs in the ring — come and sing!
The ring is to sing, we already won the fight
Text tapped out, text stepped out of sight
Text to sound — that’s up to you
Sing it back to me, let the whole world feel it too
Song pal time!
Cool pal, sung pal, this one’s for the crew
We don’t text no more…
We sing it back to you
[Outro] (fade with beatbox + soft choir echoes)
Song pal time…
Text tapped out…
But the song…
The song is sung.
That’s up to you.
